payload.task_text:
I need to build a comprehensive research knowledge base for our team studying large language models. Start by searching for recent scholarly papers on topics like "large language models", "prompt engineering", and "in-context learning". Find at least 5 relevant papers.

Then use the paper repository to download and read the full content of the most relevant papers. Analyze their LaTeX source when available to extract detailed methodology sections.

Write and run a Python script called research_synthesizer.py in the workspace that reads papers_metadata.json and papers_contents.json (create both first), extracts key methods, creates a citation network map, calculates relevance scores, and outputs research_synthesis.json.

Create an Excel file called Research_Knowledge_Base.xlsx with three sheets. The first sheet Paper_Catalog should have columns Paper_ID, Title, Authors, Year, Category, and Citation_Count, sorted by Citation_Count descending. The second sheet Method_Comparison should have columns Method_Name, Paper_Source, Key_Innovation, Benchmark_Result, and Applicability ("High", "Medium", "Low"). The third sheet Research_Gaps should have Gap_Area, Current_State, Opportunity, and Priority ("Critical", "Important", "Nice-to-have") columns with at least 4 identified gaps. In the Excel file, write all values as literal text/numbers directly into the cells; do not use Excel formulas.

Create a Notion page titled "LLM Research Hub" with a heading "Large Language Model Research Dashboard". Add paragraphs covering research landscape overview, key papers summary, methodology comparison highlights, and identified research gaps with recommendations for future work.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, use exactly one paper-processing wave. The main agent first reads all task-visible guide and team-interest files, then issues bounded native-parallel searches for the three literal topics `large language models`, `prompt engineering`, and `in-context learning` in both Scholarly and local arXiv. Union by stable ID, reject off-topic results by title/abstract, and freeze exactly five strongest papers covering all three topics in a literal dispatch table `{agent_no, paper_id, title, citation_count, category}`.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 5 explore sub-agents through one same-template AgentSwarm call:

   1. explore 0 (academic-literature-researcher 0): Explore 0 owns only dispatch-table row 1 and its literal paper ID.
   2. explore 1 (academic-literature-researcher 1): Explore 1 owns only dispatch-table row 2 and its literal paper ID.
   3. explore 2 (academic-literature-researcher 2): Explore 2 owns only dispatch-table row 3 and its literal paper ID.
   4. explore 3 (academic-literature-researcher 3): Explore 3 owns only dispatch-table row 4 and its literal paper ID.
   5. explore 4 (academic-literature-researcher 4): Explore 4 owns only dispatch-table row 5 and its literal paper ID.

For its one row, each explore sub-agent retrieves/downloads and reads the full local paper, inspects available arXiv-LaTeX sections, and writes one unique `paper_<safe_id>.json` containing exact metadata, authors, year, citation count, category, abstract, full-content/method evidence, benchmark evidence, and source-supported references. Return only its path, ID, schema/count controls, and read status. Do not write any required final filename or modify Notion.

After Wave 1, the main agent checks the five paths and IDs once, consolidates them into `papers_metadata.json` and `papers_contents.json`, writes and runs `research_synthesizer.py` exactly once, and verifies `research_synthesis.json`. It then creates `Research_Knowledge_Base.xlsx` and the single `LLM Research Hub` page as independent native-parallel output branches from that verified synthesis. The workbook must use exactly `Paper_Catalog`, `Method_Comparison`, and `Research_Gaps`, literal values, citation-descending catalog rows, controlled applicability labels, and at least four evidence-backed gaps. The page must contain the exact dashboard heading and the four requested substantive sections. Read each final output once and do not dispatch another wave.

nodes.text:
Build a scholarly evidence package for an LLM research knowledge base. Search recent papers spanning large language models, prompt engineering, and in-context learning; select at least 5 highly relevant papers. Use arXiv/scholarly search, then download the most relevant papers into the paper repository and read full content. Where available, inspect LaTeX source/sections to extract detailed methodology. Deliver a concise but structured report with for each selected paper: arXiv ID, exact title, authors, year, category/topic, citation count if discoverable (otherwise explicitly provide a defensible proxy/0 and label it), abstract-level relevance, detailed method, key innovation, benchmark result, applicability High/Medium/Low, and references/citation links among the selected set. Also identify at least 4 research gaps with current state, opportunity, priority. Include enough source-grounded detail for creation of metadata/content JSON, a citation-network map, an Excel catalog, and a Notion dashboard. Read-only; do not create files.
Research recent LLM papers

Create and verify the local research artifacts in the accessible workspace only: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-arxiv-research-pipeline-notion-excel/workspace. Required files: papers_metadata.json, papers_contents.json, research_synthesizer.py, research_synthesis.json. Use the six-paper evidence below. Metadata/content JSON must be substantive. The Python script must actually read the two input JSON files, extract/normalize key methods, create a citation network map, calculate transparent relevance scores, and write research_synthesis.json. Run it, then validate output JSON. Include repository/full-text/LaTeX acquisition status accurately: direct repository searches/downloads and LaTeX retrieval were attempted but failed with no records; do not claim successful full-content reads. Papers: P1 2005.14165 Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (Brown et al., 2020, cs.CL, GPT-3 175B autoregressive Transformer, zero/one/few-shot; LAMBADA 76.2 zero-shot/86.4 few-shot); P2 2201.11903 Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models (Wei et al., 2022, cs.CL, rationale-augmented few-shot prompting; GSM8K PaLM 540B 56.9 vs 17.9 standard); P3 2203.11171 Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models (Wang et al., 2022, cs.CL, sample multiple rationales then majority answer; +17.9 GSM8K, +11 SVAMP, +12.2 AQuA, +6.4 StrategyQA, +3.9 ARC-C); P4 2211.01910 Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers (Zhou et al., 2022, cs.LG/cs.CL, APE candidate instruction generation/scoring; >=human on 19/24 instruction-induction tasks); P5 2209.11895 In-context Learning and Induction Heads (Olsson et al., 2022, cs.CL, mechanistic probes/interventions for induction heads; phase transition evidence); P6 2211.15661 What Learning Algorithm Is In-Context Learning? Investigations with Linear Models (Garg et al., 2022, cs.LG, synthetic function-learning prompts and estimator comparisons; approaches least-squares-like behavior). Citation counts must be numeric literal 0, clearly marked as availability proxy/not actual. Citation edges: P2->P1, P3->P2, P3->P1, P4->P1, P4->P2, P5->P1, P6->P1; conceptual P6->P5. Include at least these four gaps: unified causal account of ICL Critical; prompt robustness/distribution shift Critical; faithfulness of generated reasoning Critical; cost-aware inference/prompt search Important. Ensure relevance scoring yields sensible differing values and explains formula in output. Return file paths and verification summary.
Build research artifact files

Create and verify /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_gpt-5.6-sol/SingleUserTurn-arxiv-research-pipeline-notion-excel/workspace/Research_Knowledge_Base.xlsx using the source artifacts papers_metadata.json, papers_contents.json, and research_synthesis.json in that same directory. It must contain exactly three sheets: Paper_Catalog, Method_Comparison, Research_Gaps. Paper_Catalog columns exactly Paper_ID, Title, Authors, Year, Category, Citation_Count and include all six papers sorted by Citation_Count descending (ties may retain P1-P6 order); numeric citation counts must be literal 0 and the availability-proxy caveat can be noted in cell comments only if supported, otherwise not needed. Method_Comparison columns exactly Method_Name, Paper_Source, Key_Innovation, Benchmark_Result, Applicability and cover useful methods from the six papers; Applicability values only High, Medium, Low (map Medium–High to Medium if needed). Research_Gaps columns exactly Gap_Area, Current_State, Opportunity, Priority with at least four gaps; Priority only Critical, Important, Nice-to-have. All cell values must be literal text/numbers; do not use formulas. Apply clear professional formatting (headers, widths/wrapping, freeze panes/table styling if supported). Verify workbook metadata, sheet names, populated ranges, sorted catalog, allowed enum values, and absence of formulas. Return path and verification details.
Create Excel knowledge base

Create and verify a Notion page titled exactly "LLM Research Hub". Because no parent page/database was provided, search the accessible Notion workspace for a suitable general team/research parent page and create it as a child there; if multiple are available choose the most general workspace/team home. Add an H1 heading exactly "Large Language Model Research Dashboard". Add substantive paragraphs/sections covering: (1) research landscape overview, (2) key papers summary, (3) methodology comparison highlights, and (4) identified research gaps with recommendations for future work. Base content on six papers: GPT-3 few-shot learning (2005.14165); Chain-of-Thought (2201.11903); Self-Consistency (2203.11171); Automatic Prompt Engineer (2211.01910); In-context Learning and Induction Heads (2209.11895); What Learning Algorithm Is In-Context Learning? (2211.15661). Include accurate benchmark highlights (CoT GSM8K 56.9% vs 17.9%; self-consistency +17.9 points GSM8K; APE >= human on 19/24 tasks) and research gaps: causal mechanisms of ICL, prompt robustness/distribution shift, reasoning faithfulness, cost-aware inference and prompt search. Explicitly state that citation counts were unavailable and stored as 0 availability proxies, and full-text/LaTeX repository retrieval attempts returned no records, so methods/results are evidence synthesis pending final source audit. Create the page, then retrieve it and children to verify title, heading, and all required coverage. Return page ID, URL, chosen parent, and verification summary.
Create Notion research hub
